services.name: Sunset Whale Watch
services.desc: Whales and sunsets - a Maui must-do. From January through March, the Maui Diamond transforms from a dive boat into your front-row seat for one of the ocean’s greatest shows. Join us for an intimate Maui sunset whale watch, where humpback whales breach and play against the golden backdrop of a Hawaiian sunset. Unlike larger tour boats, we keep our whale watch trips to just 20 guests maximum - even though our 46-foot boat is rated for 49 passengers. That means more space to move around, unobstructed views, and a relaxed, personal experience. We usually return to the harbor just after sunset, making this the perfect way to wrap up your Maui day. services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Looking for the ultimate Maui ocean experience? Whether you’re planning a once-in-a-lifetime dive trip, an unforgettable family snorkel day, a peaceful memorial at sea, or a special celebration like a birthday or proposal - booking a private boat charter with Maui Diamond Sea Sports means the boat (and the ocean magic) is all yours. With your own 46’ Newton dive boat, licensed captain, and professional crew, you’ll enjoy a fully customized experience in comfort and style. Let’s make some waves - your way. Because you deserve to have the boat all to yourself. No sharing with strangers. No rushing the itinerary. Just you, your group, and the freedom to create your perfect day at sea. Popular

quotes.author: Reza Zaheri
quotes.text: Reza Zaheri01:05 14 Aug 26A very professionally run dive operator. I had fun hanging with these guys today, and with Brian my dive guide took us for some epic diving at Molokini Crater. Most importantly, they take safety very seriously, and also generously set up & clean all your gear for you without you touching anything (thank you Nick). A personal shout out to Jack the Captain as well for being welcoming, and a cool cat. Thank you for today, it was a wicked trip

quotes.author: Heather Morey
quotes.text: Heather Morey20:30 27 Aug 26My husband and I went with this group as we are avid divers. Great experience. Our dive master David was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. This company actually wants you to burn your tank where so many other companies just give you a quick 30 minute dive and bring you back to the boat. Great crew and great company! Use this company if you dive in Maui!

quotes.author: Noura Tagdiri
quotes.text: Noura Tagdiri23:49 28 Aug 26Definitely best company I’ve ever dived with. Staff was knowledgeable and kept the boat extremely organized in a very relaxed and humorous way. They also do literally everything for you it’s like a valet scuba experience (set up gear, fill tanks, help you on and off boat). Did two dives and both were consistently very well run!

quotes.author: Checker
quotes.text: Checker07:56 11 Aug 26We had a incredible experiences today with Maui Diamond Sea Sports. We went to the Molokini Crater, two of us took scuba dives and the others went snorkeling. We had a blast ! Thank you for the support in organizing my nephew’s PADI certificate from home! Perfect team, we felt very safe and comfortable! Highly recommended!

quotes.author: Daniel Haslam
quotes.text: Daniel Haslam17:08 31 Jul 26Had a wonderful 2 tank dive at Molokini with Maui Diamond. Crew was great, equipment worked well and we saw some beautiful reefs. It was nice to be on a larger boat even though the weather was perfect. I’m sure I would have appreciated it even more if it was not. I absolutely would dive with them again.

quotes.author: kiana tagdiri
quotes.text: kiana tagdiri19:39 28 Aug 26Absolutely incredible experience!! We went on four dives with Maui Diamond, all of which were completely out of this world. I saw so many critters that I couldn’t even keep count, and the crew members were so kind, organized, and extremely funny. I would 1000% recommend!!
